title: Flat 4B
summary: Three flatmates, one small kitchen, a landlord who likes surprise visits.
toneNote: Warm and wry; nobody is in danger, everybody is a little embarrassed.
setting: Flat 4B is a cramped third-floor rental above a bakery. Three people who met through an ad share it, its radiator that knocks at night, and a fridge with a strict shelf system that nobody follows.
rules: Ordinary modern life. No crime, no violence; conflict is social.

factions.name: Mr. Petrov
factions.desc: The landlord. Owns the bakery downstairs.
